Auditor
The Auditor's Office provides a number of services to the citizens of the County including auditing of all financial records of the County.
Coroner
The Coroner is responsible for the investigation of unattended deaths within the confines of Lawrence County.
County Assistance
County assistance is available for those in need, including medical and economic assistance.
Emergency Management
The Lawrence County Emergency Management Department performs the functions of planning, organization, coordination, training, equipment, and facility reviews relative to disaster response and preparations. Lawrence County Emergency Management also coordinates and manages the Lawrence County Search and Rescue Team.
Equalization
The purpose of the Equalization department is to offer residents an explanation of assessments on their property and to obtain owner occupied application forms.
Extension
Browse newsletters and 4-H Youth Advisor program reports in the Extension
GIS/Mapping
Highway
Find information regarding members of the highway department as well as contact information for the department.
Information Systems & Technology
The Information Systems and Technology Department provides a wide variety of information systems and technology support to all offices of Lawrence County.
Invasive Species Management
The Invasive Species Management Department is responsible for the control of noxious weeds within Lawrence County.
Maintenance
The Maintenance Department is responsible for the upkeep of all buildings and grounds in the Lawrence County.
Planning & Zoning
The Planning and Zoning Department is responsible for managing the physical growth of the unincorporated area of the county.
Public Defender
Find information relating to the Public Defender department.
Register of Deeds
The Register of Deeds office is the primary record keeping and archival repository for county land records.
Search & Rescue
The purpose of the Lawrence County Search and Rescue (LSCAR) is to assist in searches and rescues within Lawrence County and the surrounding area when requested through the Office of Emergency Management.
Sheriff's Office
View information about the Lawrence County Sheriff's Office, including information about community outreach programs, the county jail, and contact information.
State's Attorney
State's Attorney's Office
Treasurer
The Treasurer’s Office is best known by the public for issuing motor vehicle licenses and collecting property taxes.
Veteran Service
The Veteran Service Officer assists veterans of the United States Armed Forces, their dependents and survivors, living within Lawrence County, in applying for and acquiring earned VA benefits.
